summary: Optional clipboard text encryption and safer portable backup.

changes.title: Hidden private settings
changes.detail: Hold the settings header and enter the existing secret code to access protected Brain details. Removed public fingerprint entry points; private session expires or locks when Settings leaves the foreground.

changes.title: Credential recovery
changes.detail: Recovery is visible only in the armed private search window. Existing device credential protection remains for changing the saved code.

changes.title: Live protected-session state
changes.detail: The hidden settings hub now observes current authorization even when Android retains its navigation graph, and expired or restored locked routes return to the ordinary Settings screen.

changes.title: Private details available throughout the unlocked session
changes.detail: Ordinary BR Brain shows a details link only while the hidden secret-code session is authorized. Locked Settings does not advertise it.
